title: About myself
excerpt: A psychology graduate, writer, and researcher exploring the quieter corners of the human mind through psychology, poetry, research, and stories that make us feel a little less alone.
body:
## About Me

I’m **Zaira Imtiyaz**, a psychology graduate, writer, and researcher with a deep interest in the quiet complexities of the human mind and the stories people carry within them.

My journey with psychology began as an academic pursuit, but gradually became something much more personal. Studying human behaviour, emotions, relationships, and mental health taught me that people are rarely as simple as the stories we tell about them. This understanding continues to shape both my writing and the way I see the world.

Alongside psychology, writing has always been my way of making sense of thoughts that are difficult to say aloud. I have written and published a book exploring psychological aspects of life, and I am currently working on my second book, centred around **parenting and the emotional world of children and families**.

My interests extend to **mental health, psychological research, human behaviour, relationships, loneliness, resilience, and the emotional experiences that often remain unspoken**. I have also worked on research related to PTSD and OCD and have gained practical exposure through psychology internships, mental-health settings, teaching, content writing, and work involving psychological assessment and interaction.

I believe that psychology is not confined to textbooks or clinical rooms. It exists in the way we love, grieve, attach, withdraw, heal, remember, and become.

This space is where I bring together those two sides of me **the psychology graduate who observes the mind, and the writer who listens to the heart.**

Here, you’ll find my poetry, reflections, articles, and pieces of thought inspired by psychology, life, and everything in between.
